node.statement: Apply lem-maincb-isomorphism-unit-control to B_U oplus B_V, A_R, and v: the preceding threshold gives ||v(I_{B_U oplus B_V})-u_{A_R}||<=C_iso_unit*(delta+epsilon_{A_R})<=C_iso_unit*(M+1)*t<=D_3*t.
